We have a purchase order for Redwood services (PO #789) that landed last week. Our AP team has placed the invoice on a payment hold because the invoice shows VAT charged and we're a UK VAT-registered B2B customer. To process payment we need either:

Hi Karen — thanks for the heads up. Cc'ing Ben (Billing) and Marcus (Tax/Legal) to get this handled.

Short answer: we can issue an amended invoice that treats the sale under EU reverse-charge provided Brightfly is VAT-registered and can provide a valid VAT ID for the billing entity. To move forward we need:

- the company VAT number (format GBXXXXXXXXX for the UK)
- confirmation of the billing entity name and address that should appear on the invoice
- preferred payment method (wire/ACH) and bank details reference if any

If you can send the VAT ID, we'll validate it against VIES and issue a corrected invoice with the line item: "Reverse charge — customer to account for VAT under Article 194" and 0% VAT so your AP can release payment. 

I'm attaching our internal checklist for reverse-charge invoice processing so you can see what we'll include. We'll aim to reissue the invoice within 24 hours of VAT validation.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
